name: qwickapps-plugins
description: QwickApps plugin marketplace for Claude Code

plugins.name: qwickapps-ux-design
plugins.description: QwickApps UX design system enforcement. Replaces frontend-design with framework-aware version. Enforces @qwickapps/react-framework components and --theme-* CSS variables.

plugins.name: qwickapps-dev-guide
plugins.description: QwickApps developer guidance skills. Start with use-stack to configure tech stack, then reference qwickapps-cms, qwickapps-server, and qwickapps-react-framework for per-package patterns.

plugins.name: qwickapps-sdlc
plugins.description: Complete software development lifecycle management. Issue-driven workflows, quality gates, agent personas, and engineering discipline skills. Replaces the superpowers plugin and the ai-sdlc-workflows Claude commands.

plugins.name: cloud
plugins.description: Oracle Cloud free-tier infrastructure provisioning. Interactive planning, VM allocation, guided setup of CapRover, PostgreSQL, OpenClaw, and free SaaS services.

plugins.name: deploy
plugins.description: Deployment workflow generator for CapRover apps with QwickWay gateway. Generates GitHub Actions workflows, provides battle-tested deployment scripts, and troubleshooting guidance.

plugins.name: secrets
plugins.description: Encrypted environment variable management with SOPS+age. Resolve, generate, and sync env vars across local dev, GitHub Actions, and CapRover from a single encrypted environments.yml.
